title: Finance System Integration Analyst
description:
**About Skyspecs:**

  

At SkySpecs, our mission is to simplify renewable asset management so less can do more for the planet. SkySpecs is making this possible by automating wind farm operations and maintenance with advanced robotics paired with our custom-built asset performance management software, Horizon.

SkySpecs launched the world's first completely autonomous blade inspection product in 2016 with a custom-designed drone system. Since then, SkySpecs has inspected over 90% of the US wind turbines and expanded globally, becoming the world leader in understanding the health of turbine blades. Identifying issues with turbine blades is only the first step. In 2019, SkySpecs launched Horizon, a platform for SkySpecs to offer a multi-layered solution for customers that includes: data collection, wind turbine blade engineering expertise, and a place for all stakeholders to collaborate to manage and analyze massive amounts of data, spot trends, and create plans for high-cost repair campaigns. In 2021, SkySpecs acquired two companies specializing in wind turbine drivetrain monitoring and financial management, further expanding our asset management portfolio. Ultimately, this will help reduce the cost and risk of operations for the industry.

**What will you be getting into?**

We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Finance Systems Integration Analyst to support the implementation and ongoing operation of the Horizon Finance platform. This role will help coordinate integrations between outsourced service providers (OSPs), client accounting systems, and internal reporting platforms.

Working closely with the Portfolio Manager for Integrations, the successful candidate will support data onboarding, monitor integration progress, troubleshoot data issues, and help ensure financial data is accurately uploaded and processed within Horizon Finance.

The role sits at the intersection of finance, technology, and operations, and requires strong analytical, communication, and organisational skills.

**As a Finance Systems Integration Analyst, you will:**

* Assist with onboarding new outsourced service providers (OSPs) to the Horizon Finance platform.
* Coordinate the collection of financial data from external accounting systems.
* Support the mapping of charts of accounts between OSP systems and the Horizon Finance structure.
* Review uploaded financial data for completeness and accuracy.

**Data Management & Validation:**

* Assist in preparing and transforming financial datasets for upload into Horizon Finance.
* Perform quality checks on uploaded accounting data and bank statement files.
* Investigate and resolve data discrepancies or formatting issues.
* Maintain documentation of data structures, mappings, and integration processes.

**Operational Coordination:**

* Act as a point of contact for OSP integration queries and follow up on outstanding data requests.
* Track integration progress across multiple funds and service providers.
* Maintain integration timelines and task lists.
* Assist in organising training sessions and guidance materials for OSP users.

**Reporting & Analysis:**

* Support reconciliation and validation of financial information within the platform.
* Assist in monitoring integration performance and identifying opportunities for process improvement.
* Prepare internal updates on integration progress and key issues.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Help identify opportunities to streamline data ingestion and automation processes.
* Assist in testing new system features and enhancements within Horizon Finance.
* Support the development of best practices for financial and operational data integration.

**Requirements of the job:**

* 1–3 years of experience in finance operations, data analysis, or financial systems integration.
* Strong communicator who can collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple integration processes and data onboarding timelines simultaneously.
* Solid analytical skills with experience in data mapping, reconciliation, and troubleshooting financial data discrepancies.
* Comfortable working in a fast-moving, evolving technology environment.

**Bonus Points:**

* Strong attention to detail and high accuracy in data entry
* Basic understanding of accounting principles or management accounts
* Solid comprehension of financial data structures and reporting
* Experience or interest in financial systems integration and technology

**Perks of the Job:**

* Time Off: Generous leave policy—among the best in the industry.
* Global Team: Work with teammates across 5 countries and diverse backgrounds.
* Impact: Help build the backbone of clean energy digital infrastructure.

title: Senior Executive – General Ledger (GL) Accounting
description:
**About JV Ventures**

JV Ventures is a 10-year legacy investment and ecosystem-building platform with approximately USD 550 million in assets under management, active across education, life sciences, healthcare and managed-habitat sectors through its platforms — PowerEd, PoweRx and PowerPod. The organization builds GRIDS (Growth-Ready Innovation Destinations) that combine high-quality real assets with enabling services to create cohesive, high-performance ecosystems with measurable societal impact.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Semi-Qualified Accountant with strong fundamentals in accounting and hands-on experience in General Ledger (GL) management. The candidate will be responsible for managing day-to-day GL operations, month-end closing and reconciliations, and for ensuring the accuracy and compliance of financial books in Tally and ERP.

**Key Responsibilities – GL & Accounting**

**General Ledger (GL) Accounting**

* Manage complete GL accounting, including journal entries, accruals, prepayments and provisions.
* Ensure timely month-end and year-end closing of books.
* Perform balance sheet reconciliations — bank, vendor, customer, inter-company, loans and other accounts.
* Review and post entries related to purchases, sales, expenses and fixed assets.
* Maintain the Chart of Accounts and ensure correct accounting heads are used.
* Ensure compliance with GST, TDS and other statutory requirements in accounting.
* Prepare monthly MIS, schedules and supporting documentation for financial reporting.
* Assist in internal and statutory audits — preparation of audit schedules and responses to audit queries.
* Identify gaps in existing processes and suggest improvements to reduce manual intervention.

**Required Skills**

* Semi-Qualified CA / CMA / MBA in Finance with 3–5 years of experience in GL accounting
* Strong knowledge of Accounting Standards, GST and TDS.
* Hands-on experience in Tally and ERP systems.
* Advanced Excel skills — VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIF, etc.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Current CTC
* Expected CTC
* Notice Period

Experience:

* GL Accounting: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Pricing Analyst
description:
**Our Company**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You’ll Do**

* Work within Salesforce to develop and manage pricing quotes, with the ability to identify potential risks and opportunities.
* Process Salesforce amendment quotes, working closely with Order Management, Finance and Sales Operations teams
* Provide price structuring and scenario analysis in alignment to a sales strategy.
* Become an expert in the pricing structures, tools and processes used by Deal Desk, including Salesforce quoting tools.
* Work closely with Deal Managers to support a Teradata sales organization.
* Consolidate opportunity pricing and prepare pricing and deal financials to support revenue recognition analysis.
* Evaluate business terms and conditions to ensure they are in line with Teradata policy.
* Monitor price and cost changes within Teradata, and other product information as it impacts deals.
* Understand Teradata’s data analytics technology and competitor products and commercial / pricing tactics.

**Who You’ll Work With**

As a Pricing Analyst in Teradata's Deal Desk organisation. You will work alongside the EMEA team, supporting the Deal Manager on operational pricing activity and supporting sales teams on proposal pricing, deal development and analysis. The Pricing Analyst structures and evaluates customer deals by utilizing Teradata’s pricing tools and provides vital counsel to Deal Managers, Account Teams and Sales Management on product offerings, pricing options, contract terms and conditions, competition, and price negotiation techniques. You will conduct bid reviews and provide or secure bid approval as required.

On a day-to-day basis, you will help to win business and increase profitability by developing accurate pricing proposals and making recommendations on pricing options. In close cooperation with Deal Managers, you will work cross-functionally with the Account Teams, Finance, Order Management, Revenue Recognition, Product Management and other functions across the company. The position reports to the Regional Deal Desk Director.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Demonstrated analytical, financial and commercial skills gained through formal education, certification or work experience.
* Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of two years related work experience.
* Strong capability in Excel. Good capability with PowerPoint and other Microsoft Windows applications.
* Experience with Salesforce or equivalent CR Mand CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) systems would be beneficial.
* Self-directed individual who is proactive.
* Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills. Ability to work closely with multiple functional areas to achieve desired outcomes.
* The ability to professionally discuss business issues with management and offer advice and alternatives.

**What You’ll Bring**

Knowledge of Salesforce CPQ, web-based applications, sales support tools. Prior experience in pricing, deal desk or finance roles, or roles related to procurement.

title: Analyst / Senior Analyst - Finance
description:
**Company Description**

**Enviri Corporation** is a market-leading global provider of environmental solutions for industrial, retail, and medical waste streams, as well as innovative equipment and technology for the rail sector. We have an unrivaled breadth of experience across the globe and an impressive reputation that stretches back more than a century. Based in Camp Hill, PA, with more than 8500 employees and the company operates in more than 30 countries.

**About Enviri GSC**

Enviri GSC handles a wide range of services, including finance and accounting shared services, global HR shared services, providing IT services and helpdesk support, and market research support to Harsco globally. We have been operating since 2008 & serving 30+ Countries

 **Job Description**

**Purpose:** The Finance Business Partner serves as the primary finance representative and Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for assigned legal entities, regions, and business stakeholders. This role is accountable for financial integrity, governance, compliance, business support, statutory reporting, financial analysis, process excellence, and continuous improvement across the end-to-end finance organization.

The position acts as the bridge between Business Operations, Shared Services, Corporate Finance, Tax, Treasury, FP&A, Internal Audit, and External Auditors while ensuring accurate financial reporting, robust controls, and effective decision support.

**Position Summary and Primary Responsibilities**

1. Business Partnership & Stakeholder Management

* Function as the primary Finance SPOC for assigned business units, legal entities, and operational leaders.
* Serve as the trusted advisor to business management on financial and operational matters.
* Translate business requirements into finance solutions and actionable insights.
* Provide decision support through financial analysis and business recommendations.
* Facilitate alignment between Business, GSC, Corporate Finance, Tax, Treasury, and FP&A teams.
* Lead periodic financial review meetings with stakeholders.

2. Legal Entity Controllership & Financial Governance

* Own overall financial governance and performance of assigned legal entities.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of financial statements and management reports.
* Review monthly trial balances, financial results, and key accounting judgments.
* Coordinate period-end close activities across multiple finance functions.
* Monitor compliance with company accounting policies, US GAAP, IFRS, and local statutory requirements.
* Drive financial discipline and accountability across the legal entities.

3. Financial Reporting Quality

* Ensure timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting.
* Review financial statements, disclosures, and support schedules.
* Validate reporting packages submitted to Corporate Finance.
* Ensure consistency, transparency, and quality of management reporting.
* Identify reporting risks and implement remediation plans.
* Support HFM, FCCS, NetSuite, and other consolidation and reporting platforms.

4. Balance Sheet Governance & Reconciliation Review

* Review and approve all balance sheet reconciliations on a recurring basis.
* Challenge aged balances, unusual transactions, and unreconciled items.
* Ensure compliance with global reconciliation policies.
* Drive timely resolution of balance sheet exceptions.
* Review intercompany balances and eliminations.
* Monitor account certification and sign-off processes.

5. Financial Planning & Analysis Support

* Coordinate FP&A data collection and validation activities.
* Support annual budget, forecast, and strategic planning processes.
* Consolidate financial data and business assumptions.
* Analyze variances against budget, forecast, and prior periods.
* Support scenario modelling and sensitivity analysis.
* Provide data-driven recommendations to leadership teams.

6. Financial Analysis & Decision Support

* Perform profitability, margin, and cost analysis.
* Evaluate operating performance and identify business drivers.
* Analyze trends impacting revenue, expenses, working capital, and cash flow.
* Develop management dashboards and KPI reporting.
* Support strategic initiatives, investments, and capital expenditure reviews.
* Prepare executive-level financial presentations and business reviews.

7. Statutory Audit & Regulatory Compliance

* Lead finance coordination for annual statutory audits.
* Serve as the primary contact for external and internal auditors.
* Manage audit schedules, requests, and deliverables.
* Review statutory financial statements and disclosures.
* Coordinate audit adjustments and remediation actions.
* Ensure timely closure of audit findings and recommendations.

8. Tax Support & Compliance

* Partner with Corporate Tax and external advisors on tax compliance matters.
* Support corporate income tax, indirect tax, transfer pricing, and statutory filings.
* Review tax account reconciliations and tax-related balance sheet accounts.
* Assist in tax audits and regulatory inquiries.
* Ensure completeness and accuracy of tax provisions and reporting.
* Monitor tax risks and compliance requirements.

9. Contract Management & Commercial Support

* Partner with Procurement, Operations, and Legal teams on contract reviews.
* Review commercial terms, pricing structures, and financial obligations.
* Assess accounting, compliance, and financial implications of contracts.
* Monitor contract performance and financial commitments.
* Support contract renewals, amendments, and business cases.
* Drive governance and visibility through contract management practices.

10. Global Process Setup & Transformation Support

* Support establishment of new accounting processes, entities, and business operations.
* Lead finance workstreams during acquisitions, integrations, carve-outs, and restructuring initiatives.
* Assist ERP implementations, migrations, and global process deployments.
* Partner with global process owners to standardize finance activities.
* Support automation, digitization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Drive adoption of best practices across regions.

11. Transition Management

* Lead migration of activities into or out of Shared Services.
* Develop transition plans, governance frameworks, and risk assessments.
* Coordinate knowledge transfer activities and stabilization support.
* Ensure seamless handover of processes and controls.
* Monitor transition milestones and stakeholder commitments.
* Support post-transition performance reviews and process optimization.

12. Controls, Compliance & Risk Management

* Ensure adherence to SOX, internal controls, and corporate compliance requirements.
* Monitor effectiveness of finance controls across assigned entities.
* Identify process risks and implement corrective actions.
* Support internal audit and compliance reviews.
* Promote strong governance and accountability culture.
* Ensure segregation of duties and policy adherence.

13. SOPs, Desk Procedures & Process Documentation

* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Prepare and update Desk Procedures and Process Narratives.
* Maintain end-to-end process flow documentation.
* Ensure documentation aligns with actual operating practices.
* Support training and onboarding through process documentation.
* Drive standardization across regions and functions.

14. Leadership & Continuous Improvement

* Lead cross-functional finance improvement initiatives.
* Mentor finance team members and support capability building.
* Drive Lean, Six Sigma, automation, and process optimization opportunities.
* Promote data-driven decision-making and accountability.
* Champion finance transformation initiatives across the organization.

  
**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience**

* Professional degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business, or MBA with specialization in Accounting/ Finance.
* Inter CA / CMA/ CWA / ACCA / CIMA.

* Lean Six Sigma certification is advantageous.
* Experience of 2 to 4 years working as a finance manager or finance controller
* Have a clear understanding of all financial modules.
* Ready to work in the afternoon shift - 2.00 PM to 11.00 PM IST

**Interpersonal Skills**

* Excellent communication skills (Written and verbal) and Good interpersonal skills.
* Able to build and maintain sound relationships with individuals at all levels and with onsite clients.
* Results-driven with the ability to work under pressure.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from senior management.
* Adapt to a multicultural environment.

**Technical Skills**

* Financial Reporting & Controllership, Legal Entity Management, Business Partnering
* FP&A and Forecasting
* US GAAP / IFRS, Statutory Accounting & Audit, Internal Controls & SOX
* Tax Compliance, Contract Management, Shared Services Operations
* ERP Systems (NetSuite, Oracle, SAP, HFM, HP, FCCS), Power BI and Advanced Excel

**Key Success Factors and KPI’s**

* Financial close completed within timelines, Balance sheet reconciliation compliance (>98%), zero material audit findings.
* Forecast accuracy achievement.
* Statutory filing compliance, Control effectiveness, and SOX compliance
* Financial reporting, quality, and accuracy
* Stakeholder satisfaction scores, Successful transition, and transformation initiatives
* Process standardization and automation benefits realized.

  
**Additional Information**

**Disclaimer**

The information about this job description given above has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

title: Real Estate Accounting - Senior Process Analyst
description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

**About Broadridge:**
---------------------

**Broadridge Financial Solutions** is a global fintech leader providing technology, communications, and data-driven solutions to the financial services industry. We help businesses simplify complex operations, enhance efficiency, and deliver better experiences for their clients.

With a strong global presence and a culture built around innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement, Broadridge offers employees the opportunity to work on meaningful, large-scale business processes while building expertise in a dynamic and technology-driven environment.

At Broadridge, our values are reflected through **CREATE – Client Focus, Respect, Excellence, Accountability, Teamwork, and Efficiency**, which guide how we work and collaborate every day.

**Position Summary:**
---------------------

The **Real Estate Accountant** is responsible for accounting activities supporting the company’s real estate and lease portfolio, with primary responsibility for right-of-use (ROU) asset and lease liability accounting. This role manages lease and facility expense accounting, prepares and records journal entries, performs balance sheet reconciliations, supports close activities, and assists with SOX compliance and annual audit requirements. The ideal candidate has strong knowledge of accruals, prepayments, amortization, variance analysis, and lease accounting processes.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Manage accounting for ROU assets and lease liabilities, including initial recognition, monthly amortization, lease payments, modifications, remeasurements, and other lease-related activity.
* Perform lease expense accounting and ensure lease-related expenses are recorded accurately and timely.
* **Prepare, review, and post recurring and non-recurring journal entries, including:** Utility expense accruals, Personal property tax accruals and payments, Rent expense and rent-related entries, Prepaid rent and prepaid tax amortization, ROU asset amortization, Facility expense allocations, Asset retirement obligation (ARO) accounting and related adjustments, Other real estate, occupancy, and lease-related expenses
* Manage prepayments and amortizations for rent, taxes, utilities, facilities, and other assigned expenses.
* Prepare month-end adjustments and support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities.
* Prepare and perform balance sheet reconciliations for security deposits, lease liabilities, ROU assets, prepaids, asset retirement obligations, and other assigned real estate-related accounts.
* Investigate, resolve, and document reconciling items, account variances, and discrepancies in a timely manner.
* Perform balance sheet flux analysis and provide explanations for material period-over-period changes.
* Perform profit and loss variance analysis for real estate, lease, utility, and facility-related expenses.
* Reconcile lease subledger activity and related general ledger balances, ensuring alignment between **Visual Lease and Oracle Fusion**.
* Maintain supporting documentation for journal entries, reconciliations, lease calculations, account analyses, and audit requests.
* Support SOX compliance by preparing control evidence, maintaining process documentation, and assisting with control testing activities.
* Assist with internal and annual external audits by providing schedules, reconciliations, documentation, and explanations for real estate-related account balances.
* Coordinate with Real Estate, Facilities, Accounts Payable, Tax, Treasury, Financial Reporting, and other internal stakeholders to obtain information needed for accurate accounting.
* Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, internal controls, reconciliation procedures, documentation, and reporting.
* Support ad hoc reporting, analysis, and special projects as assigned.

**Why Join Broadridge?**
------------------------

At **Broadridge**, you will have the opportunity to:

* **Build expertise in global finance operations** and work with complex accounting processes supporting a global organization.
* **Work with leading finance technologies**, including platforms such as Oracle Fusion and Visual Lease.
* **Collaborate across functions and geographies**, partnering with Finance, Real Estate, Facilities, Tax, Treasury, Accounts Payable, and Financial Reporting teams.
* **Drive process improvements** and contribute to automation, controls, and operational efficiency.
* **Develop your career** through exposure to diverse accounting processes, stakeholders, and global business operations.
* Be part of a culture that values **innovation, inclusion, collaboration, and continuous learning**.
* Work in an environment where your contributions have a direct impact on the quality, accuracy, and efficiency of global financial operations.

### **Be part of Broadridge. Build what's next.**

**Join us and grow your career while helping transform the way global businesses operate.**

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.

**Use of AI in Hiring**

As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

title: Financial Analyst – Content Moderation
description:
**Experience:** 1+ Year  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Mode:** On-site  
**Industry:** Financial Services / Content Moderation / Business Operations

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented Financial Analyst with at least 1 year of experience in financial analysis, transaction review, or content moderation. The ideal candidate will be responsible for reviewing financial content, analyzing financial data, identifying misleading or non-compliant information, and ensuring adherence to established financial policies and content guidelines.

The candidate should have strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to assess financial information for accuracy, compliance, and potential risks.

Key Responsibilities

* Review and moderate financial content, including financial posts, advertisements, investment-related content, and user-generated financial information.
* Analyze financial data, reports, transactions, and business information to identify discrepancies, unusual patterns, and potential risks.
* Evaluate content for accuracy, misleading financial claims, fraud indicators, and policy violations.
* Apply content moderation guidelines and financial compliance policies consistently.
* Identify potentially fraudulent investment schemes, misleading promotions, scams, and other suspicious financial activities.
* Conduct quality checks and maintain accurate records of reviewed content and financial findings.
* Escalate high-risk content, policy violations, and complex financial cases to the appropriate teams.
* Meet established productivity, accuracy, and quality targets while maintaining compliance with service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Prepare reports on moderation trends, financial discrepancies, risk patterns, and quality metrics.
* Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive financial information responsibly.
* Stay updated on internal policies, financial regulations, and content moderation procedures.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum of 1 year of experience in financial analysis, financial operations, transaction monitoring, content moderation, or a related role.
* Experience reviewing financial content, financial advertisements, investment-related information, or user-generated content is preferred.
* Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify inconsistencies and potential risks.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Basic to intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.
* Ability to work with defined policies, quality standards, productivity targets, and deadlines.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.

Preferred Skills

* Familiarity with financial products, investment terminology, banking, accounting, or financial markets.
* Knowledge of content moderation workflows, policy enforcement, and risk assessment.
* Experience identifying misleading financial claims, fraudulent promotions, scams, or suspicious content.
* Exposure to compliance monitoring, KYC, AML, fraud detection, or transaction review processes.
* Familiarity with dashboards, data analysis tools, and case management systems.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Content review accuracy and quality scores.
* Daily productivity and case resolution targets.
* Compliance with moderation policies and procedures.
* Timely escalation of high-risk content.
* Reporting accuracy and attention to detail.
* Adherence to SLAs and confidentiality requirements.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate combines financial knowledge with content evaluation skills. They should be comfortable analyzing financial information, identifying potentially misleading or fraudulent claims, applying moderation policies, and making consistent, evidence-based decisions.

**Equal Opportunity Statement:** We welcome qualified candidates from diverse backgrounds and evaluate applicants based on their skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

Pay: ₹350,000.00 - ₹420,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: Risk Analyst
description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

**Job Description**
===================

**Who we are**


With over $2\.5 trillion of assets under management, Invesco is one of the world’s leading global investment management firms, headquartered in Atlanta, GA. Spreading across 26 countries and with over 8400 dedicated employees, we are driven by trust and care. As one of the world’s leading asset managers, we are solely dedicated to delivering an investment experience that helps people get more out of life. If you're looking for challenging work, thoughtful colleagues, and a global employer with social values, explore your potential at Invesco.

**Your Team**


The Risk Measurement Team owns and manages a global portfolio risk data platform (MSCI RiskMetrics) that provides ex\-ante market risk measurement, stress\-testing and liquidity risk data to a plethora of stakeholders (Investment Risk Management, Risk Oversight, Product Development, Legal and Compliance, Client Reporting). Risk Measurement is a 2nd line of defence function owning the ex\-ante market and liquidity risk models for Regulatory Risk.

**Your Role**

* Under the guidance of the APAC Risk Measurement TL contribute to build and maintain an integrated risk measurement infrastructure that reflects the Global risk monitoring needs.
* Ensure risk measurement capabilities and outputs are continuously improved and adjusted based on the evolution of the regulatory, statutory, or corporate portfolio risk measurement requirements.
* Monitor, analyze and report market risk, liquidity risk, leverage across global funds.
* Provide comprehensive and high\-quality portfolio risk measurement, analysis, and reporting.
* Collaborate with the global Risk Measurement teams as well as the other Investment Risk functions to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the global platform.
* Provide expert support to all stakeholders in research/quantitative/qualitative analysis of portfolios.
* Provide expertise in terms of local products, investment processes, trading strategies, market characteristics.
* Develop expert level understanding of the markets in general and potential impact on portfolio risk.
* Ensure all activities are in line with Invesco’s Conduct principles.

**The Experience You Bring**

* 2\-4 years of experience in Marker Risk/Liquidity Risk
* Understanding of risk models and statistics such as VaR, Volatility, Tracking Error etc.
* Sound understanding of financial instruments at theoretical level incl. pricing methodologies for derivatives.
* Working knowledge of at least one programming languages like SQL, Python, etc
* Knowledge of risk systems such BarraOne, Blackrock Aladdin, Axioma would be a plus.

**Academic requirements**

**Formal Education:**

* MS, B.Tech
* CFA / FRM / CQF certification preferred but not mandatory

In Invesco, we do meaningful work to create impact for our stakeholders. We believe our culture is stronger when we all feel we belong, and we respect each other’s identities, lives, health, and well\-being. We come together to create better solutions for our clients, our business and each other by building on different voices and perspectives. Our global focus on diversity and inclusion has grown exponentially and we support connection and community through our many employee\-led Business Resource Groups (BRGs).

title: Health Plan Pricing Analyst
description:
TriNet is a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small to midsize businesses (SMBs). We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full\-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance.  

  

TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR.

**Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that many potential applicants discourage themselves from applying to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. TriNet always strives to hire the most qualified candidate for a particular role, ensuring we deliver outstanding results for our small and medium\-size customers. So if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody’s perfect – and we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.**

**A Brief Overview**  

The Health Plan Pricing Analyst is responsible for ensuring the appropriate collateral is received and determining the appropriate medical rate is assigned for a prospect. Analysts use specialized tools developed by third party industry experts and TriNet's carrier partners to evaluate submitted documents and census information to determine the correct medical pricing for prospects based on the actual risk they present.  

  

**What you will do**

* Work independently to conduct prospect census review including medical plans and rates, to determine the appropriate medical price based on the presented risk of the prospect
* Evaluate required documents using various tools including a medical pricing tool
* Communication with Sales collegues
* Assist with reviewing and evaluating output of the tools and resources TriNet uses and making suggestions for improvements on these tools and Health Plan Pricing process
* Performs other duties as assigned
* Complies with all policies and standards

 **Education Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience required

 **Experience Qualifications**

* Typically 2\+ years required
* Experience in insurance pricing preferred

 **Skills and Abilities**

* Ability to interpret and analyze detailed medical plans and related documents
* Ability to solve problems using mathematical skills
* Possess independent thinking skills and complete projects with minimal guidance
* Ability to handle multiple tasks at once
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite with intermediate skills in Excel
* Ability to communicate with Sales personnel regarding Health Plan Pricing guidelines and requirements

 **Travel Requirements**  

Minimal  

  

**Work Environment**

* Work in a clean, pleasant, and comfortable office work setting. The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable persons with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* This position is 100% in office.

  

Please Note: TriNet reserves the right to change or modify job duties and assignments at any time. The above job description is not all encompassing. Position functions and qualifications may vary depending on business necessity.

title: Senior Financial Services Analyst
description:
**Business Unit:**
==================


Cubic Transportation Systems**Company Details:**
====================


When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
  

  

We have a top\-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.**Job Details:**
================

**Job Summary**


Responsible for all back\-end settlement transactions and the reporting associated with these tasks including timely reconciliation of all accounts assigned. This position typically works with general supervision and direction. Incumbents of this position will regularly exercise discretionary and substantial decision\-making authority.

**About the Role**


Are you a detail\-oriented financial professional with a passion for data, reconciliation, and process improvement? We’re looking for a Senior Financial Services Analyst to join our dynamic team and play a key role in managing high\-volume settlement transactions and financial reporting. This is a great opportunity for someone with strong accounting fundamentals, analytical skills, and a collaborative mindset.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Accurately settle high\-volume financial transactions and ensure timely reconciliation of assigned accounts.
* Monitor and ensure smooth data transfers between systems such as Microsoft Dynamics, external payment processors, and settlement banks.
* Reconcile directed fund movements with actual results and prepare standard/ad hoc reports on clearing and settlement activity.
* Perform complex data analysis and identifies any financial discrepancies
* Address discrepancies and communicates them with key stakeholders
* Enter and manage debit/credit transactions with precision.
* Investigate chargebacks and coordinate with merchant banks and credit card issuers.
* Assist in preparation of processes and procedures documentation
* Analyze payment processing fees to identify cost\-saving opportunities.
* Reconcile General Ledger accounts and support financial close activities.
* Oversee, review, and guide the day\-to\-day activities carried out by the junior team members, ensuring accuracy and adherence to process.

**What We’re Looking For**


We’re seeking candidates who bring more than just experience—they bring energy, curiosity, and a team\-first attitude. The ideal candidate will have:

**Required Qualifications:**

* CA Semi\-Qualified with completed articleship; a Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance is an added advantage.
* Minimum 4 years of post\-articleship accounting experience, with a strong working knowledge of debits, credits, and reconciliations.
* At least 1 year of experience in a team handling or supervisory capacity.
* Advanced Excel skills with hands\-on experience managing large datasets; knowledge of Power Query, Pivot Tables, and Power BI is desirable.
* Familiarity with Electronic Funds Movement processes and financial systems.
* Exposure to data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau is a plus.
* Strong communication skills with a proactive, solution\-oriented mindset.
* Collaborative team player with a positive attitude and the ability to adapt in a dynamic environment.
* Well\-organized, self\-driven, and capable of working independently under general supervision.


‎


**Worker Type:**
================


Employee
‎


*We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based on any protected characteristic under applicable law.*

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
**Why CBRE Business Services Organization (BSO):** When you join CBRE Business services Organization (BSO), you become part of a global leader in commercial real estate and investment services that help businesses and people thrive. At CBRE\- Business services Organization (BSO), We are dynamic problem solvers and forward\-thinking professionals who create significant impact. CBRE Business Services Organization (BSO), Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people and you have the opportunity to realize your full potential.
  
Job Title – Senior Financial Analyst
  
**About the Role:** The employee will be responsible for managing end to end cash, banking, and related financial operations, ensuring strong governance, accuracy, and compliance across all processes. This role requires a high level of attention to detail, process excellence, and effective collaboration with cross functional teams.
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

Develop, document, and implement policies, processes, and internal controls related to cash management, banking, and Accounts Payable/Accounts Receivable.
  
Manage daily banking operations, including cash/bank reconciliations, expense allocation, and revenue allocation.
  
Establish and maintain effective working relationships with Payments, Banking, Treasury, Service Desk, OTC, Project teams, and other internal stakeholders.
  
Perform reconciliation of revenue and expenses across systems, bank statements, and the general ledger.
  
Ensure full compliance with SOX requirements, loss prevention practices, and always maintain audit readiness.
  
Minimize unreconciled items and ensure aged open items from bank reconciliations are addressed promptly.
  
Process, review, and approve journals and requests with 100% accuracy and in accordance with Best in Class (BIC) standards.
  
Involve in Balance Sheet reconciliation preparations and reviews and ensure account reconciliations are prepared and completed with 100% accuracy and high\-quality standards.
  
Execute month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end closing activities, demonstrating a commitment to exceptional delivery.
  
Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliations and complete related reporting activities adhering to BIC standards.
  
Manage Pay in Full (PIF) requests and payment voiding activities as required.
  
Identify, propose, and implement process enhancements, best practices, and automation opportunities to improve productivity and output quality.
  
  

**What You'll Need:**  

Bachelor’s degree in accounting; professional certifications are an added advantage.
  
Experience in managing multi site cash and banking operations with diverse income streams.
  
Strong reconciliation capabilities with excellent attention to detail.
  
Proficiency in English, including strong verbal and business writing skills.
  
Effective communication skills with the ability to interact confidently with management across Finance and Business teams.
  
Experience working in a large global organisation and within a matrix structure.
  
Strong business acumen with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  
Solid understanding of finance systems and technical integrations; experience with SAP, AX Dynamics, i\-Scala \& PeopleSoft/MyFinance is an advantage.
  
Willingness to work from the office during the KT and Stabilization phase, followed by hybrid work as per management direction.
  
Commitment to going the extra mile to achieve high\-quality outcomes.
  
Flexibility and adaptability to support management with process improvement, AI, and finance transformation initiatives.
  
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively.
  
  

**Company Perks and benefits:**  

**Health Care:** Health Insurance to Self, Immediate family \& Parents/In\-laws
  
Accident \& Term life Insurance for all employees Accident \& Term life Insurance for all employees.
  
**Food \& Snacks:** Free Meals \& snacks are provided in all shifts.
  
**Mental Wellbeing:** A confidential service that provides facility of counselling to keep you emotionally \& mentally well while dealing with the challenges.
  
**Child Care:** We partner with Klay day care and CBRE employees get 100% waiver on admission fee. This Day school is in our HYD campus.
  
**Entertainment:** On floor \- Chess, Carrom board, Table tennis, Foosball.
  
**Our Values in Hiring:** At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.
  
CBRE Business Services Organisation (BSO) is a part of CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE: CBRE): CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE: CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S\&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm (based on 2023 revenue). The company has more than 130,000 employees (including Turner \& Townsend employees) serving clients in more than 100 countries. CBRE serves a diverse range of clients with an integrated suite of services, including facilities, transaction, and project management; property management; investment management; appraisal and valuation; property leasing; strategic consulting; property sales; mortgage services and development services. Please visit our website at www.cbre.com. We routinely post important information on our website, including corporate and investor presentations and financial information. We intend to use our website as a means of disclosing material, non\-public information and for complying with our disclosure obligations under Regulation FD. Such disclosures will be included in the Investor Relations section of our website at https://ir.cbre.com. Accordingly, investors should monitor such portion of our website, in addition to following our press releases, Securities and Exchange Commission filings and public conference calls and webcasts.

title: Manager Finance & Accounts
description:
**Job Purpose**

To independently manage and control the company's complete Finance \& Accounting function, including accounting, banking, taxation, working capital, receivables, payables, cash\-flow management, MIS reporting, statutory compliance and financial controls.

The candidate will be responsible for independent financial decision\-making within approved company policies and limits, ensuring accurate accounting, timely statutory compliance, optimum utilization of funds and strong financial discipline across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**  
**Finance \& Accounting Management**

Independently manage day\-to\-day Finance \& Finalisation of Accounts operations.  
Reconciliation’s of salary payables and advances, Loans recovery.  
Independently operate and manage Tally Prime accounting software.  
Independently handle the ESI, EPF, PT provisions and implementations in HR Dept.  
Independently manage GST notices, orders, replies, assessments, and demand proceedings.  
Strong knowledge of E\-Way Bill provisions, rules, regulations, and compliance requirements.

**GST, TDS \& Statutory Compliance**

Ensure timely compliance with GST, TDS and other applicable statutory requirements.

Review GSTR\-1, GSTR\-3B, GSTR\-2B reconciliation, annual GST returns, GST input tax credit, e\-invoicing, e\-way bills and debit/credit notes.

Review TDS applicability and deductions under applicable sections.

Ensure timely TDS payments and returns.

Reconcile TDS records with books and relevant portals.

Coordinate with CA/Tax Consultant for assessments, notices and statutory matters.

Maintain proper documentation for tax audits and statutory audits.

**Required Skills \& Knowledge**

Strong knowledge of Finalization of Accounting Operations.

Advanced knowledge of Tally Prime Edit log.

Strong knowledge of Banking Operations.

Strong knowledge of GST and TDS.  
Strong Knowledge in salary reconciliations/advance/loans (recovery concept)  
Strong Knowledge in Provision for taxation, advance tax, Tds receivable.  
**Preferred:** Construction/project accounting, industrial/service industry, project\-wise costing, ERP/accounting software, banking limits and working\-capital facilities, Bank Guarantee/LC knowledge, audit handling and experience dealing directly with CA, auditors, banks and tax consultants.

**Educational Qualification:**

Mandatory: B. Com / M. Com / CA Inter or equivalent qualification.

Preferred: CA / CMA / ACCA qualification or equivalent professional exposure with relevant exposure.

**Experience**

Minimum: 6 years relevant experience.

Preferred: 6 – 10\+ years.

The candidate should have previously handled Finance \& Accounts with independent responsibility rather than only performing data\-entry/accounting\-executive functions.

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a strong, hands\-on Finance \& Accounts Manager who can independently take ownership of the Finance Department.

The ideal candidate should be commercially minded, analytical, responsible and capable of making practical financial decisions. The person should not be limited to bookkeeping and should have the ability to understand the complete business cycle from Purchase → Inventory/Project → Sales → Receivables → Banking → Cash Flow → Profitability.

The candidate must be comfortable dealing independently with Management, Banks, Customers, Vendors, Auditors, CA/Tax Consultants and internal departments.

Core Competencies: Accounting \+ Banking \+ Taxation \+ Tally Prime \+ Working Capital \+ MIS \+ Commercial Understanding \+ Team Management \+ Decision Making.

Pay: ₹60,000\.00 \- ₹85,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
